newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-QBE nears record high on profit hike.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-QBE nears record high on profit hike.

text.p: Shares in QBE Insurance Group Ltd rose more than three percent on Monday and just off its record high after the insurer announced a higher profit for the year to June 30, 1996 and a one-for-four bonus issue.
At 12.35 p.m. (0235 GMT), QBE shares were 24 cents or 3.16 percent higher at A$7.84, just off its record high of A$7.85 hit on August 23.
QBE earlier reported a net profit after movement in unrealised gains on investments of A$147.3 million in the year to June 30, 1996, compared with A$123.3 million a year earlier.
QBE also announced a one-for-four bonus issue which entitles shareholders to receive the final dividend of 17 cents a share.

"I think people are pleased with the bonus issue, its like getting a 25 percent increase in the dividend," one Sydney-based broker said. QBE shares were trading at around A$7.55 before the results announcement.
